name: qa-playground-tests
description: The QA Playground page has Mini Web Apps that I use to showcase my test skills.

scripts.test:report: node --test report-tests/build/build-report.test.mjs report-tests/build/check-results.test.mjs && playwright test -c playwright.report.config.mjs
scripts.test:visual: docker run --rm --ipc=host -v "$PWD":/work -v /work/node_modules -w /work -e PW_VISUAL=1 mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.65.1-noble bash -c 'npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && npx playwright test --grep @visual'
scripts.test:visual:update: docker run --rm --ipc=host -v "$PWD":/work -v /work/node_modules -w /work -e PW_VISUAL=1 mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.65.1-noble bash -c 'npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && npx playwright test --grep @visual --update-snapshots=all'

author: Roberto Castillo
